queue_snapshot.note: Point-in-time read-only observation, not a live progress endpoint.

claims: Processed data are participant/condition mean curves on101 normalized points, distinct from individual raw cycles.
Published illustrations concern right-leg curves; this does not establish every left-leg anatomical mapping.
Pinned archive version6 describes51 participants:24 young,27 older.
Original model, pipeline and metadata are provided.
Sharing and adaptation require attribution, a license link and indication of changes.

scope_for_first_addition.grid: Source101 points interpolated to150 inclusive0–100% points; interpolation adds no new information.
scope_for_first_addition.canonical_channels: Only source-supported right sagittal angles and moments; left remains source-coordinate channels.

admission_gates.evidence: Frozen candidate/source evidence and pinned live API agree on source identity and license; cohort discrepancy explicitly versioned.
Requires guarded summary status ensemble_pilot_source_readback_passed_unreviewed and unchanged frozen hashes.
Require subject FU18_01, comfortable overground, two side-specific ensemble IDs,300 rows and150 inclusive phase points per observation. Never report full archive coverage from the pilot.
Inspect source preservation/missingness results; retain unsupported anatomical mappings as missing and all observation/timing caveats.

Use existing release tooling only after it is shown to preserve observation_type ensemble_curve, source-coordinate channels and exact reported scope. Include paper, versioned data DOI, license and transformation notice.
Point only to an existing immutable artifact after review; label participant-condition means prominently. Do not show stride statistics, inferred opposite-leg phase, SD or an individual-cycle count.

Inventory each subject/condition ensemble from the pinned archive, count omissions explicitly and obtain bounded sources sequentially. The first addition can be a clearly labeled two-ensemble preview; it cannot imply a completed full dataset.
Needs per-recording clock/event/foot identity review. The older event archive lacks54 current walking counterparts; absence in that archive is not proof of missing embedded current C3D events.

additional_validation_recommendation.reason: The frozen serial job already performs an independent source readback with identity, metadata, exact columns and before/after hash checks. Do not duplicate it or add competing numerical work.
additional_validation_recommendation.safe_followup_after_completion: Read the small guarded summary, conversion manifest and readback report; verify their hashes and compare exact scope to these gates. If successful, first review the existing release builder ensemble support with synthetic fixtures before creating a review bundle.

suggested_attribution.paper: A public dataset of overground and treadmill walking kinematics and kinetics in healthy individuals. PeerJ6:e4640(2018). DOI10.7717/peerj.4640.
suggested_attribution.changes: LocoHub separates left/right participant-condition means, linearly interpolates101 source points to150 inclusive phase samples, converts supported right angle units to radians and applies documented right moment sign mappings. Other source-coordinate channels are retained; missing timing and unsupported measurements are not invented.
